name: Dream Scraper
detailed_description:
"We require your services in DREAM SCRAPER INC.

Get ready to dive into dreams, catch the creatures haunting people in their dream and save those who are trapped in their sleep by scraping the dream.

Join us in DREAM SCRAPER INC. and help us to get rid of these creatures from people's dreams.

In a usual day, creatures appeared out of nowhere in some people's dreams and they made those people unable to wake up from their sleep.

DREAM SCRAPER INC. get funded by some rich people with the purpose of getting rid of those creatures. As an agent of DREAM SCRAPER INC. you're a Scraper whose job is diving into people's dreams and catching those creatures.

Scrapers are chosen talented indivisuals since they need to be careful, dreams can change depending on trapped person's personality and what's happening in the dreams effects Scrapers' physical body."

About this game:

Dream Scraper is a game with 9 different genres. Each dream you will dive into is a different section with different genre and the game gives you different mechanics, emotions and controls in each of these section.

  • You will shoot creatures with different weapons in a dream, parkour and overcome obstacles with movement tools in another dream, collect resources to build a village and raise an army in another one and do much more in other dreams.

  • After scraping the dream and completing your mission you will go to the company building for getting information about your new mission. You can speak with your co-workers and explore the company's secrets while you are there.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These requirement will probably change in the future.
